result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, the same order as the sales rep list.

The change is one query in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (around line 10021). I copied the `ORDER BY` from `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep` and updated the Javadoc to match. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

The only caller is `RegionManagerService`, which doesn't depend on the old order. I ran `RegionManagerTest`, `SupportTicketTest`, `TicketsPerRegionTest`, `ClosedTicketsTest` and `DemoScenarioTest` offline, and all 15 tests pass. I did not add a new test for the priority order, so your example ordering (T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1) is not covered by an automated check yet. Nothing is committed.
